title: Liquidity tool ambiguity retry attribution
caseBrief: Determine whether the liquidity buffer trend justifies escalation and attribute any retry behavior to prompt or tool ambiguity.

availableDataSources.description: Synthetic liquidity coverage ratio time series

syntheticPackReferences.purpose: Load the ambiguous liquidity dataset that can trigger retry-prone tool choices.

expectedOutcomes.summary: The liquidity buffer trend warrants escalation once the ambiguous metric labels are resolved against policy terminology.

ambiguityHotspots: The prompt uses the generic word buffer instead of the policy term liquidity coverage ratio.
Two tools appear capable of answering the stress-window question.

optionalContext: Treasury analyst note about terminology drift
distractorContext: Legacy dashboard label using the word buffer without definition
duplicateContext: Two overlapping tool descriptions for stress-window analysis

agentRenderingNotes.toolChain: The agent should attribute retries to ambiguous tool surfaces or prompt wording instead of silently looping.
agentRenderingNotes.workspace: A workspace version would normalize terminology before any tool selection happens.

expectedOutcomeCriteria.correctnessExpectation: The answer must resolve the ambiguous metric label to the policy-defined ratio and still reach the escalation conclusion.
expectedOutcomeCriteria.expectedDisposition: Escalate the liquidity review and clarify the metric mapping in the final answer.

feedbackTurns.summary: The first draft retried tools without clearly explaining whether the ambiguity came from the prompt or the tool catalog.
instructions: Clarify how the policy maps the term buffer to the liquidity coverage ratio.
Attribute the retry risk to prompt wording or overlapping tools in the final explanation.
correctedFacts: The policy term is liquidity coverage ratio, and retry risk came from overlapping tool surfaces plus ambiguous wording.

memoryTargets.description: Retain the mapping between the ambiguous prompt wording and the policy term for the rerun.

memoryOpportunities.summary: The prompt word buffer should be mapped to the policy term liquidity coverage ratio.

memoryCheckpoints.rationale: The rerun should retrieve the terminology mapping to avoid repeated ambiguity.
